items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: how old was I when I joined him, it was in ‘76 I think, ‘76 when I joined him. And I was with him for about four years.

ctx.x: Was Benny Goodman still — he was hot then, right?

He was hot about that time. I loved his trio things, you know, the trio and the quartet, the small things. And he was really an idol of mine, and it took until I was — how old was I when I joined him, it was in ‘76 I think, ‘76 when I joined him. And I was with him for about four years.
